attributes.fresh: Whether all required source observations satisfy the configured age and timestamp-coherence rules.
attributes.positive_direction: The canonical direction represented by a positive state value.
attributes.reason: The stable machine-readable explanation for the selected source or current unavailability.
attributes.sources: The contributing entity IDs, raw values, raw units and observation timestamps.
attributes.valid: Whether the normalized sample passed source, unit, sign and topology validation.

entities.definition: Canonical instantaneous house-battery power; positive values mean charging and negative values mean discharging.
entities.time_basis: Current normalized observation for the coordinator update cycle
entities.availability: Unavailable unless the configured signed source or coherent charge/discharge fallback produces a valid sample.

equivalents.foxess: Configured battery power or charge/discharge telemetry

entities.definition: Current house-battery state of charge used by HEO planning and safety policy.
entities.availability: Unavailable when the configured battery SoC source is absent or invalid.

entities.definition: Current vehicle state of charge copied into HEO's canonical site snapshot.
entities.availability: Unavailable when EV support is not configured or the mapped vehicle SoC is absent or invalid.

entities.definition: Instantaneous grid-export magnitude calculated from canonical signed grid power; zero while importing.
entities.availability: Unavailable when canonical grid power cannot be calculated.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite non-negative numeric value or unavailable

equivalents.foxess: Derived from the configured signed grid-power telemetry

entities.definition: Instantaneous grid-import magnitude calculated from canonical signed grid power; zero while exporting.
entities.availability: Unavailable when canonical grid power cannot be calculated.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite non-negative numeric value or unavailable

equivalents.foxess: Derived from the configured signed grid-power telemetry

entities.definition: Canonical instantaneous site exchange with the grid; positive values mean import and negative values mean export.
entities.time_basis: Current normalized observation for the coordinator update cycle
entities.availability: Unavailable unless the configured source has a valid unit, sign convention and sufficiently fresh observation.

entities.definition: Canonical instantaneous whole-house consumption used by HEO after configured normalization.
entities.availability: Unavailable when the configured or derived house-load observation is invalid.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite non-negative numeric value or unavailable

entities.definition: Canonical current on the most-loaded site phase used to enforce service-import headroom.
entities.time_basis: Current normalized observation for the coordinator update cycle
entities.availability: On multiphase sites unavailable without valid mapped phase-current evidence; on single-phase sites may be derived from coherent grid power and voltage.

equivalents.foxess: Mapped most-loaded phase current or single-phase derived current

entities.definition: Canonical instantaneous solar-generation magnitude after configured normalization.
entities.time_basis: Current normalized observation for the coordinator update cycle
entities.availability: Zero with configured-absent evidence at a no-solar site; otherwise unavailable when the configured source is invalid.
entities.state_vocabulary: Finite non-negative numeric value or unavailable
